correctness.rationale: The additive Fourier matrix on the origin and three punctured radial arms has a 4-dimensional constant multiplicative-character sector and three-dimensional sectors for each nontrivial multiplicative character, exactly 3q-2 dimensions. Direct complex elimination makes the constant block injective even when w=1+t^2=0. Nontrivial sectors map chi to chi^(-1); their nonzero Gauss factor isolates a matrix with identity leading 2x2 block and determinant condition chi(w)=1+chi(z), z=t^2, w nonzero. Unit-modulus character values force the two conjugate prescriptions (omega,xi)=(e^(2pi i/3),e^(pi i/3)), each with N/|<z,w>| extensions, or neither. For w=0 the condition chi(-1)=-1 gives N/2 in odd characteristic and zero in characteristic two. Discrete logarithm congruences give the stated exact resonance arithmetic, including q=2 and extension-field boundary cases. Direct independent SVD evaluation of all slopes in GF(5),GF(7),GF(11),GF(13) agreed with predicted nullity; finite tests are only corroboration.
residual_risks: Exact complex ranks only for the normalized three directions and symmetric finite-field dot pairing, no claim of orthogonality or general projective line configurations.

The subgroup-index nullities distinguish isotropic and genuinely sixth-root obstructions, and characteristic-two universal invertibility has a clear structural basis.
